cardSpecification.objective:
Reconcile, audit, and certify all cross-plane adversarial and telemetry permutation outcomes delivered in Phase 4.
Verify that 100% of the 16 cross-plane permutation vectors defined in the retest plan pass cleanly with zero regressions.
Audit evidence artifacts to guarantee that no security breach, token leakage, or data corruption occurred across test runs.
Enforce git tree cleanliness and verify that integration branch refs/heads/integration/slaat-whole-system-adversarial remains green.
Author the Phase 4 Governance Certification report, generate cryptographic checksums, and formalize hand-off to the release pipeline.
cardSpecification.approach:
Inspect ci-evidence/slaws-slaat-permutation-baseline.json to verify that totalVectors equals 16 and passedVectors equals 16.
Execute regression tests test/slaws-slaat-cross-plane-probes.bats to validate permutation runner stability under repeated invocation.
Verify documentation formatting and link health in docs/signalloom/retest-plan-slaws-slaat-permutations.md via scripts/docs-lint.sh.
Validate that all five defensive layers (Envoy, FastAPI, SPIFFE, OpenBao, Sentinel/Landlock) maintained strict default-deny invariants.
Check git status across the workspace and verify that zero untracked files or unintended diffs pollute the integration branch.
Compile the final Phase 4 Governance Certification report into ci-evidence/phase4-governance-certification.json and digest files.
Update proposal work decomposition tables with certified test metrics, execution costs, and completion status records.
Issue formal sign-off attesting that SLAAT adversarial defenses withstand concurrent SLAWS telemetry ingestion load.

SHA-256 cryptographic digest file ci-evidence/phase4-governance-certification.digest locking evidence integrity against tampering
Comprehensive governance audit report ci-evidence/phase4-governance-certification-report.md summarizing test results and defense postures
Updated proposal document docs/Proposal - SLAAT Whole-System Autonomous Adversarial Testing (2026-Q4).md recording phase completion
Audit log verification records confirming zero security exceptions, zero memory leaks, and zero dropped frames
Release hand-off attestation file certifying readiness for downstream multi-agent governance and production deployment

Checksum discrepancies between baseline evidence files and recorded certification digests
Untracked temporary debug files left in working directory violating clean-tree governance requirements
Broken internal markdown links or style guideline violations detected by scripts/docs-lint.sh
Flaky BATS tests failing during repetitive evaluation cycles due to uncleaned temporary files
Unmerged commits or dangling branches preventing clean synchronization to the integration baseline
outOfScope: Re-running upstream SLAAT Phase 1, Phase 2, or Phase 3 attack harnesses from scratch
Modifying production deployment manifests or cluster topology configurations
Altering cryptographic root keys or re-issuing SPIRE intermediate certificates
Refactoring core application code in signal-ingest, policy-engine, or dashboard services
Modifying external CI/CD pipeline triggers or cloud infrastructure definitions

All five SLAAT defense surfaces are required to maintain strict fail-closed security postures
SLAWS telemetry ingestion operates concurrently without frame loss or database schema corruption
Governance certification requires complete evidence manifests and cryptographic digest signatures
Board cards must maintain strict dependency ordering and satisfy size band specification floors

Any discrepancy between recorded test counts and required 16-vector matrix baseline
Any unresolvable dependency cycle or missing prerequisite card identified on the kanban board
